entry_item.definition: v, i. To move one after another in single file; to file in; to fall in drops or single grains, trickle, drip.

example.definition: One after another (in space or time), in a sequence
To enter one after another, file in.

entry_item.definition: 1 dégoutter , découler, couler sans cesse: 2 aller l'un après l'autre: 3 (parler) coulamment.
To empty or discharge itself. To flow into something.
〔动〕①流，注流，倾注：цус ~ 流血；②排成纵列，成一串，鱼贯前进，一个接一个地走：~н нисэх 纵队飞行；цувж орох 鱼贯而入；③（把曲卷的东西）打开，拉展，拉开，松开：дээс ~ 把绳子拉开；утас ~ 把线拉展；унгас ~ 把绒毛捻长.
